facts.text: Cedric signed a promissory note to pay the party 975 gold for the barrow treasure (three-quarters price), payable only once the caravans flow again.
facts.uncertain_reason: The note was used to recruit Malzazarik and Lady Hilda (beat_62); unclear whether the party handed it over or still holds the claim.

facts.text: The party owes Malzazarik and Lady Hilda payment backed by Cedric's promissory note, in exchange for their joining the party; due once Cedric pays out.
facts.uncertain_reason: The exact terms of the recruitment (handing over the note versus promising its proceeds, and the shares) were not stated.
